title: Detail page shows launch reliability and offers a fix at the failure moment
description: Playdock records every launch outcome it drives (LocalOutcomeTracker); the detail view now shows it: a quiet 'N launches, no errors' line when things work, and - when the last 2+ launches failed - a warning banner with one-tap 'Find a Working Configuration' (CompatibilityFinder inline). The support loop closes at the moment of failure instead of pointing at a log folder.
commit_message: Detail page: launch-reliability banner with inline Compatibility Finder
